capabilities: Navigate Bases results by first, previous, next, last, or direct page number
Set standard or custom page sizes from 1 to 1,000 rows
Paginate native grouped results with manual group order and hidden groups
Render native property types such as links, tags, images, formulas, and dates
Persist page size, sticky header, and pagination position per view
extras: Requires the native Bases result limit to be removed or raised; rows omitted by the native query cannot be recovered. Legacy settings keys (showSearchBox, showFilterBar, filterableColumns, filterPresets, listRenderMode) are retained but no longer affect rendering.
intentEvidence: adds real page navigation to Bases
problem: Native Bases can limit query results, but a result limit gives no next/previous page controls or access to the remaining rows.

relations.evidence: composes with native Bases instead of replacing its query controls

summary: Read-only Bases view that adds page navigation, page-size options, and group-aware pagination to native Bases query results.
